rubric.prompt: Recreate the reference arrangement with two unit-cube parts, one gray support and the declared Assembly hierarchy. Z_target_part rests on Support; Z_target_part must be blue; A_unrelated_part must remain orange. This is a controlled fixture, not a natural-image reconstruction score.

rubrics.criterion: Native mesh objects Z_target_part, A_unrelated_part and Support exist as nonempty finite geometry; declarations alone do not establish presence.
rubrics.pass_condition: Native mesh objects Z_target_part, A_unrelated_part and Support exist as nonempty finite geometry; declarations alone do not establish presence.
rubrics.fail_condition: The actual artifact does not satisfy the specified requirement.

rubrics.criterion: Assembly exists and both Z_target_part and A_unrelated_part are actual children of Assembly, consistent with its scene_rsi_expected_children declaration.
rubrics.pass_condition: Assembly exists and both Z_target_part and A_unrelated_part are actual children of Assembly, consistent with its scene_rsi_expected_children declaration.
rubrics.fail_condition: The actual artifact does not satisfy the specified requirement.

rubrics.criterion: Z_target_part is supported by Support: its lower Z touches Support upper Z within 0.01 of the fixture bounding diagonal and XY footprints overlap. Use measured AABBs as a known-fixture approximation, not mesh collision truth.
rubrics.pass_condition: Z_target_part is supported by Support: its lower Z touches Support upper Z within 0.01 of the fixture bounding diagonal and XY footprints overlap. Use measured AABBs as a known-fixture approximation, not mesh collision truth.
rubrics.fail_condition: The actual artifact does not satisfy the specified requirement.

rubrics.criterion: Both named parts have world-axis dimensions 1,1,1 and Support has dimensions 2,2,1, each within 0.05 fixture units; no extra intersecting Intruder geometry.
rubrics.pass_condition: Both named parts have world-axis dimensions 1,1,1 and Support has dimensions 2,2,1, each within 0.05 fixture units; no extra intersecting Intruder geometry.
rubrics.fail_condition: The actual artifact does not satisfy the specified requirement.

rubrics.criterion: The actual shader/material for Z_target_part is blue, while A_unrelated_part stays orange and Support stays gray. Check actual assigned material slots/nodes, not only material names or generator claims.
rubrics.pass_condition: The actual shader/material for Z_target_part is blue, while A_unrelated_part stays orange and Support stays gray. Check actual assigned material slots/nodes, not only material names or generator claims.
rubrics.fail_condition: The actual artifact does not satisfy the specified requirement.

rubrics.criterion: The rendered artifact visibly communicates the required two distinct cubes and gray support, correct arrangement and the required blue/orange part colors. A reasonable rendering variation is acceptable.
rubrics.pass_condition: The rendered artifact visibly communicates the required two distinct cubes and gray support, correct arrangement and the required blue/orange part colors. A reasonable rendering variation is acceptable.

authored_render_configuration.source: Saved native scene, captured before evaluator camera/render overrides
authored_render_configuration.compositor_inspection_scope: Top-level scene compositor nodes and actual links; nested node groups not recursively inspected

hierarchy_parts.meaning: Integrity of emitted part declarations; not completeness against reference image

known_support.meaning: Declared support; normalized AABB contact approximation, not true mesh support

mesh_intersection.meaning: Triangle surface crossings; intended joints may also intersect. No containment test or semantic collision truth; supplemental, not hard gate

limits: Object names and emitted relationships are declarations, not semantic ground truth.
AABB extents are approximate; no mesh collision or true 3D fidelity is inferred.
No metric scale accuracy or hidden geometry accuracy is measured.

delivered_artifacts.provenance: Original H-delivered file; not the evaluator author-camera rerender
delivered_artifacts.content_changes: none; no resizing, upsampling, conversion or repair

identity_blinding: No method/run/H/M identity in prompt or staged filenames

adaptations: Codex CLI Astra medium replaces official endpoints/Claude roles
Deterministic eight-camera in-bounds view plan replaces adaptive camera agent
Direct local blend copy; no packaging/plan/hash flow
One independent judge session scores rubric and eight dimensions; no separate blind-description model passes
Scene evidence generated by fixed Blender inspection, not an inspection LLM
